exercise.title: Position 1 at 80, then your own drill
exercise.why: Each drill fixes a key, a tempo and a set of notes, so changing just one of them makes a new drill of your own.

cells.text:
Press Play below to start the metronome at 80. Start on the ringed {{1}} on the low E string and play both dots on each string up to the high e string, then come back down the same way.
Keep going until your hands find each next note without you thinking about it.

Now make up a drill of your own by changing one thing: the direction, the rhythm, which notes you play, or play it in double stops. Play it until it feels easy, then change another. The same shape in E is below if you want a new key.
